_why: Val = these 8 scenes, held out whole. The split this replaces took the last 5% of episode_index; that is placement-disjoint (0% leak) but every val scene and object was also in train, so val loss measured a new camera path in an already-known room. Measured before the change: scene overlap 88/88, object overlap 99/99.
_how_chosen: Scenes sorted by placement count, then every (91/8)-th taken. An even spread rather than the smallest 8: the smallest scene has 7 placements against a median of 99, so a val set of runts would be its own distribution rather than a sample of the data.
_contract: A MANIFEST, not a hash rule. A hash silently redefines the split whenever the scene list changes -- the same failure mode the export's --seed already has. Edit this file only to deliberately redefine the split, and expect val curves before and after to be incomparable.
